name: Mamre
title: Amorite ally of Abraham
summary: Mamre was an Amorite chieftain who was allied with Abraham. He is best known for the fact that Abraham lived by Mamre's terebinth grove near Hebron, and he participated together with his brothers Aner and Eshcol in the rescue mission to free Lot from the four kings. The place Mamre became an important base for Abraham and is linked to several central events in the patriarchal history.

keyEvents.title: Abraham settles at Mamre's terebinth grove
keyEvents.description: Abraham settled by Mamre's terebinth grove in Hebron and built an altar to the Lord there.

keyEvents.title: Alliance with Abraham
keyEvents.description: Mamre was an Amorite ally of Abraham, together with his brothers Aner and Eshcol.

keyEvents.title: The war against the four kings
keyEvents.description: Mamre joined with Abraham and his brothers to rescue Lot, who had been taken captive by King Kedorlaomer and his allies.

keyEvents.title: Division of the War Spoils
keyEvents.description: After the victory over the four kings, Mamre, Aner, and Eshkol are mentioned as entitled to their share of the war spoils.

keyEvents.title: The Lord's Visit at the Oaks of Mamre
keyEvents.description: It was at the oaks of Mamre that the Lord appeared to Abraham and promised that Sarah would bear a son. The place thus became associated with the promise concerning Isaac.
